intent.objective: mobile usability and reliable task completion
intent.primary_message: OMEGA-X is a calm AI workspace: start with one message and open tools only when needed.
supporting_information: Android device credentials are stored securely
Browser preview and workspace file tools are separate capabilities
intent.desired_action: Start a conversation or open a tool without losing context
intent.audience: Android-first personal-assistant users on compact mobile screens and desktop browsers

concept.visual_proposition: A full-height dark chat canvas anchors the screen around one centered welcome headline and a bottom composer, with optional task shortcuts and a separate tool workspace.
concept.visual_proof: The headline reads first, suggested tasks sit directly below it, and the composer remains accessible without vertical page scrolling.
concept.brand_specific_angle: Use the OMEGA-X wordmark and restrained neutrals rather than generic neon sci-fi effects.

hierarchy.primary: Assistant welcome headline in the empty state and the latest response in an active conversation
hierarchy.secondary: Two-by-two suggested task grid and optional tools
hierarchy.tertiary: Connection status, metadata, navigation and disclaimer
hierarchy.one_second_read: One calm headline leads directly to a message composer.

composition.aspect_ratio: Responsive Android portrait and desktop viewport
composition.hero: The welcome headline when empty; the latest assistant response during a conversation
composition.secondary_mass: Two-by-two suggested task shortcuts on first launch
composition.negative_space: Separate the headline, shortcuts, and composer with comfortable breathing room.
composition.eye_path: brand and status -> welcome or latest response -> composer -> optional tools
composition.crop_logic: Fit content to the viewport and preserve system safe areas; never clip the composer.
composition.background: Flat charcoal surfaces with clear value-based layering
composition.typography_zone: Narrow readable chat column over a quiet dark field

typography.alignment: Centered welcome headline; left-aligned conversation text; controls follow a stable grid
typography.line_break_logic: Break headlines at meaning boundaries and let response text wrap naturally.

color.value_structure: Primary text stays distinct from #212121; sidebar and composer differ by value, not competing hues.
color.accent_strategy: Restrained grayscale with a bright send action and visible focus ring.
color.contrast_target: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large display text; verify small status labels on the rendered UI.

lighting.key_direction: not applicable to a flat interface
lighting.shadow_behavior: use only subtle surface separation when it clarifies focus

brand_rules: Keep OMEGA-X naming consistent across the app.
Do not imply unsupported tools are enabled.
Do not display API setup secrets or refresh credentials in the UI.
observed_patterns: A collapsible tool workspace distinct from the chat timeline
inferred_choices: Use short labels, clear focus rings, and large touch targets for Android.
restraints: No decorative glow, particles, or neon gradients without a functional purpose
No equal-emphasis cluster of three or more primary actions
Respect keyboard viewport changes and Android safe areas
Never label command execution as working while server policy disables it
